trust_decision.summary: Only files that resolve inside constants.home_directory may be served by the unauthenticated /home/{file_path:path} route; the decision belongs in home_static_files, which must resolve the joined path and reject anything not is_relative_to(home_directory.resolve()) before FileResponse. At the pinned commit neither that route nor constants.home_directory exists: fix commit 9801ffd2 creates both unchecked (fix.diff:1780-1783) and 21c51b9 adds the check one commit later, so the pinned tree contains no instance of the flaw.

landing_point.why: The summary names the /home endpoint, and in the pinned tree the only /home hit in the router is the login_page comment at line 59 ('prevent redirect loop back to /home'), so an engineer greps here and lands in the one file where such a handler lives. Reading web_client.py:20-139 shows no route that serves a caller-supplied path, because the handler arrives with the fix's feature commit.

fix_sites.entry_point: GET /home/{file_path:path} (unauthenticated FastAPI route, created by fix commit 9801ffd2 at fix.diff:1780-1783; absent from the pinned tree)
constants.home_directory, the base directory that the handler joins with raw user input (consumed at fix.diff:1783 and fix.diff:1753)

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The route must stay unauthenticated and keep serving the landing page's real assets, including nested paths and dotted names (/home/css/styles.css, /home/favicon.png, /home/script.js, /home/khoj_app_hero_image.avif), because index() redirects logged-out visitors to /home. An over-broad fix that adds @requires(['authenticated']) or a login redirect, as several authenticated page routes in this file already do, closes the hole by breaking the landing page for exactly its intended audience; an extension or name allowlist breaks the nested css/ and image assets.
O5_coupled_behaviour.where: fix.diff:1272-1273, fix.diff:1299, fix.diff:1673 (assets the page requests); fix.diff:1761-1763 and fix.diff:1771-1777 (redirects that make /home the public entry); src/khoj/routers/web_client.py:31-32, src/khoj/routers/web_client.py:74-75 (the auth-decorated page pattern that invites the wrong fix)

O6_input_shapes: relative traversal segments ('../../etc/passwd') in the {file_path:path} converter
an absolute file_path (leading '/', e.g. //etc/passwd) which makes pathlib's `/` discard the home_directory base entirely
percent-encoded traversal (%2e%2e%2f, %2f): Starlette decodes the path converter value before the handler sees it, so a substring check on the raw request target never sees '..'
a symlink planted inside home_directory that points outside it (resolve() follows it, so the is_relative_to check catches it)

benign values that must keep working: nested subpaths ('css/styles.css'), dotted filenames ('khoj_app_hero_image.avif', 'favicon.png') and '..' sequences that still normalise inside the base ('home/../home/index.html')

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second static handler that serves the web interface tree through a path parameter (e.g. GET /static-web/{file_path:path} over constants.web_directory) instead of the single fixed assetlinks file
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This file already serves one file out of constants.web_directory through FileResponse (constants.py:8) and points Jinja2Templates at the same tree (web_client.py:16), so a maintainer adding a landing page under khoj/interface/web/home/ naturally writes exactly that handler — upstream did, one commit before it was hardened.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A hand-rolled /home FileResponse route beside the /static StaticFiles mount, or a second StaticFiles mount for the home assets
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Static assets are already mounted here; a maintainer who wants /home/css/styles.css to resolve relative to the page URL instead of a /static prefix adds a router handler rather than a mount, and a hand-rolled join is where the traversal check gets forgotten.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A new home_directory style constant beside web_directory and assetlinks_file_path that a path-taking route joins raw input onto
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: constants.py is the single place directory bases live, and assetlinks_file_path already models 'a file under web_directory served by a route'; adding a second such constant is the obvious change and moves the join into a different module from the route that performs it.

O9_family: path traversal / arbitrary file read (CWE-22) from an unsanitised path join in a static-file HTTP handler

O10_build.language: Python 3.10-3.12 (pyproject.toml:10), plus a browser JS/HTML/CSS asset tree for the landing page
O10_build.toolchain: pip/hatchling (pyproject.toml:1-3); FastAPI + Starlette app with a Django ORM side; tests run under pytest with pytest-django 4.5.2 and pytest-asyncio (pyproject.toml:120-123) using FastAPI TestClient (tests/conftest.py:258-263)
services: PostgreSQL with pgvector for the Django ORM side (pgserver 0.1.4 as a dev dependency, pyproject.toml:116)
O10_build.project_tests: No test covers the web client routes: tests/ uses TestClient only against other routers (tests/test_client.py:7,285; tests/conftest.py:4,263) and nothing references web_client, home_page or home_static_files; the fix diff adds no tests. The suite does build the real app via configure_routes(app) (tests/conftest.py:258-263), so a /home route test would slot in there.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Strip or reject '..' with a substring check on file_path, which misses percent-decoded separators, an absolute file_path that discards the pathlib base, and symlinks; the other tempting move is putting @requires(['authenticated']) on the static route, which closes the hole by breaking the landing page for logged-out users.

out_of_scope_notes: src/khoj/main.py:192 mounts Starlette StaticFiles at /static; StaticFiles normalises and contains paths itself, and it is a pre-existing unrelated file server, not the advisory's sink.
tests/conftest.py:262 mounts constants.web_directory at /static for the test app only; test-harness routing, not shipped.
unverified: Central finding: the flaw is absent at the pinned commit. src/khoj/utils/constants.py:1-8 has no home_directory, src/khoj/routers/web_client.py has no /home route, and src/khoj/interface/web/home/ does not exist (the directory holds only error.html, utils.html, base_config.html and content_source_github_input.html). fix_commits are the landing-page commit 9801ffd2 and its immediate hardening 21c51b9, so the parent-commit checkout is pre-feature and a task here requires injecting the vulnerable route.
O1=0 follows from that: the published fix closes exactly one route, GET /home/{file_path:path}, which is created at fix.diff:1780-1783 rather than present in the pinned tree.
Only the advisory summary line was supplied (no body text), so the report's literal example payload and its stated affected paths are unknown.

O8 is empty and present_in_latest is 'unknown' because no later tree and no network were available; the route list was enumerated by grepping every FileResponse, StaticFiles and path-parameter use under src/khoj at the pinned commit, which found only fixed-path FileResponses (web_client.py:134) and the /static mount (main.py:192).
Repo size in MB was not measured (no shell); the Glob inventory of 689 files, many documentation PNGs, suggests well above 5 MB and far below 1.5 GB, so neither tiny_repo nor giant_repo was flagged.

Whether an end-to-end hidden test needs the Postgres+pgvector service was not checked; the handler only touches the filesystem, but importing khoj.routers.web_client pulls khoj.database.adapters (Django) at src/khoj/routers/web_client.py:9.
The dependency install (torch 2.6.0, sentence-transformers, openai-whisper per pyproject.toml:55-77) needs network; only post-build runtime was judged offline.
single_site is flagged on the literal definition (one function, one place, no O2/O8) while noting that the function itself only exists inside the fix diff.
